persona: Invented patient: 52-year-old expatriate with low back pain after moving house. Two drug/material allergies and three regular medications.

answers.chief_complaint: I've had a bad pain in my lower back for about a week, kind of a dull ache that goes down my right leg.
answers.onset: About a week ago, I was lifting boxes when I moved house.
answers.severity: I'd say six out of ten.
answers.associated_symptoms: Some tingling in my right foot. Um, nothing else really.
answers.medications: I take metformin, twice a day, lisinopril for my blood pressure, and ibuprofen for the back, like three times a day.
answers.allergies: Yes, I'm allergic to penicillin, I got a bad rash when I was a kid. And latex too, my hands go all itchy.
answers.past_history: Type 2 diabetes and high blood pressure. Had my appendix out in 2015.
answers.events: Had breakfast around eight, oatmeal, and took my pills with it.
